|game_text='''0 side — Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi'''

Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and A Sith's Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Opponent loses 2 Force when a character hit by Vader's (or Galen's) Lightsaber leaves table on the same turn. While this side up, may ▲ Rogue Shadow. Galen's immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. Flip this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.

'''7 side — Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe'''

While this side up, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ any one card without ability. If targeting a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin's Orders, or There Is No Conflict, that destiny draw is +2. Flip this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site or if neither Vader nor Galen is on table.
|errata_history=The 0-side allows deployment of [[If The Trace Was Correct]] and allows [[Rogue Shadow]] to be taken into hand. The [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)|earlier Appendix A text]] names Galen’s Fighter. The [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 2)|April 2013 Master List]] replaces If The Trace Was Correct with [[Your Spies Have Located A Jedi?]]. The 7-side matches the Appendix A and Master List text.
